pyq_bad.why: suspect key: contesting all constituencies was never a criterion; none of the options is the actual rule
wrong topic: general election results (Congress in Kerala 2004)
wrong topic: 2004 Lok Sabha election results

patterns: APPSC asks the national-party criteria directly, often as 'which is NOT a condition' with all listed conditions valid -> 'None of the above' (APPSC-G2).
Authority trap: ECI (not President / Law Ministry / Speaker) recognises parties and allots symbols.
Which party was recognised national in a given year (TMC 2016, AAP 2023) and which listed parties are not national (RSP, Forward Bloc, PWP).
Numbers to hold: 6% + 4 LS seats in 4 States; 2% of LS seats (11) from 3 States; State party in 4 States.
App MCQs go further into Symbols Order paragraphs (15, 16A), proposers and star campaigners; accurate but deeper than PYQs.
